result.summary: I've put the Copper Finch tap-works invoice on hold. It names a different property (28 Larkspur Quay, Brindlewick) and has no amounts or work date. I've asked the contractor for a corrected, itemised invoice and for findings on the vent leak and bedroom damp, which the invoice doesn't cover. I've asked the tenant to confirm the taps are fixed and given them containment advice, and updated the landlord. I escalated the landlord's insurance and roof-leak history requests, plus the invoice mismatch, to a human. A 3-day hold is set on the contractor.

judgement.why_this_decision: The landlord approved the work by email (event 004), but the invoice (event 022 / attachment) names another property and shows no amount. It can't be forwarded or paid, and the contractor needs to correct it. The vent and damp issues were in scope (event 008) but there are no findings on them (event 021). The landlord's requests about building insurance and roof-leak history (events 004 and 005) were never actioned. Insurance is outside the maintenance remit, and the repeated water ingress needs agency judgement. That calls for a human handover, while the contractor and tenant are asked for what only they can answer.

alternatives_considered.option: Close the tap work and open a separate ticket for the roof

alternatives_considered.option: Send a new approval request to the landlord so the stage can move forward
alternatives_considered.why_not: The landlord already said yes clearly. Asking again would be redundant, so I've asked a human to record the existing approval instead.
